requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Register a new citizen user account with a valid name, unique username, and email. Verify successful registration response and session creation if applicable.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the primary entry point for citizen access to the Participium system.

requirement_summary: Citizen registration fails due to duplicate username.
prompt: Attempt to register a citizen using an existing username. Verify the system rejects the request with an appropriate error code indicating the username is taken.
setup_needed: Execute a successful registration for user 'existing_user' to populate the database.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the test user 'existing_user' created in setup.
rationale: Ensures data integrity and prevents duplicate accounts, a critical security and usability requirement.

requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
prompt: Authenticate as an external maintainer. Fetch a report currently in 'Assigned' state where this user is the assignee. Update the report status to 'In Progress'. Verify the update succeeds and the new status is reflected.
setup_needed: Create a test report via POST /reports with categoryId from GET /categories (satisfying dependency_edges). Assign the report to the authenticated external maintainer.
Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} if the API supports it, or verify no resource was created by checking the list of reports for this user.
rationale: Validates the core workflow for external maintainers to manage assigned tasks.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges information and comments on a report internally.
prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. POST a new comment to an existing report. Verify the comment is created successfully and is visible in GET /reports/{id}/comments.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member/external maintainer.
Create a test report via POST /reports with categoryId from GET /categories (satisfying dependency_edges).
Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created comment if the API supports individual deletion, or verify no resource was created by checking the comments list.
rationale: Validates internal coordination capabilities without exposing data to unauthorized parties.

requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators in the platform.
prompt: Authenticate as a citizen. POST a reply message to an existing report where a municipal operator has previously sent a message. Verify the reply is created and visible in GET /reports/{id}/messages.
setup_needed: Authenticate as citizen.
Create a test report via POST /reports with categoryId from GET /categories (satisfying dependency_edges).
Simulate a municipal operator sending a message to the report (via POST /reports/{id}/messages) to establish context.
Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created reply message if the API supports individual deletion, or verify no resource was created by checking the messages list.
rationale: Validates the two-way communication channel between citizens and operators.

requirement_summary: System administrator sets up a new municipality user.
prompt: Create a new municipality user with valid attributes (username, password, email). Assert 201 Created and verify the user appears in subsequent GET /users/municipality lists. Use an admin role for authentication.
setup_needed: Ensure a valid admin session exists (login if necessary).
Retrieve list of available roles via GET /roles to include in the payload.
cleanup_strategy: DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id} where {id} is the ID returned from this test.
rationale: Validates the core user provisioning capability for PT02.

requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to an existing municipality user.
prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'viewer') to a specific office for the target municipality user. Use the user ID and office ID obtained from previous setup steps. Assert 200 OK and verify the assignment in the response.
setup_needed: Authenticate as system administrator.
POST /users/municipality to create a test user.
GET /offices to obtain an office ID.
GET /roles to obtain a role ID.
cleanup_strategy: DELETE /users/municipality/user/{id}/office-roles/{officeId} using the specific officeId and roleId assigned in this test.
rationale: Validates the role assignment workflow for PT03.

requirement_summary: Citizen creates a report with the anonymous flag set to true.
prompt: Create a new report for an authenticated citizen user with 'anonymous': true in the payload. Assert 201 Created. Verify that the response indicates anonymity is active and the public view would hide the name (conceptually).
setup_needed: POST /auth/register to create a citizen account.
POST /auth/verify-email to activate the account.
GET /categories to obtain a valid categoryId.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the anonymous reporting feature defined in PT15.

requirement_summary: System administrator attempts to verify an email for a non-existent registration token.
prompt: Execute verification with a random UUID string that was never generated by the /auth/register endpoint. Assert 404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request.
setup_needed: Ensure a valid admin session exists (login if necessary).
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Tests robustness against random token injection attempts.

requirement_summary:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
prompt: Generate an independent workflow test that performs POST /auth/login, captures its state, then calls GET /notifications.
setup_needed: Complete POST /auth/login and retain the resulting identifiers or session state.
cleanup_strategy: Delete resources created by the workflow and restore prior state.
rationale: Session cookie from login is required to access user-specific notifications.
